Subcompartment_2: Wages + capital + taxes less subsidies (D.1 + K.1 + B.3n + net operating surplus + D.29 + D.39)
Description: Total producer-price value added per commodity on the GLORIA base: sum of the wages, capital and taxes-less-subsidies strands, taking the ISIC-A estimate for primary-agriculture items and the ISIC-C estimate only for items not in ISIC-A, plus the bio-based commodities (biofuels, building blocks, biopolymers). May be negative. Alternative to value_added_exiobase; the two bases are not additive.
Sources: FABIOv2 value-added synthesis (GLORIA base) for FABIO commodities; fabio-bfp bio-based value-added combination (GLORIA base) for the biofuel/building-block/biopolymer commodities.
